stories.headline: Brown Down for Six: Patriots' Diamond Mine Just Went Bust
stories.read: Pardner, the Patriots' big prize outta Philly caught his boot between the turf and a Seahawk in Week 1, and now he's headed to injured reserve with a high ankle sprain, out a minimum of four weeks, with insiders callin' it closer to six. That's Brown gone through the Steelers, Jags, Bills, Raiders, and Jets tilts. Every other fella catchin' passes in New England just struck a vein nobody else has found. Go pan that creek before your leaguemates do.

stories.headline: Murray Laid Up, Wentz Rides Shotgun for Jefferson's Outfit
stories.read: Kyler Murray took a hard lick against Green Bay and landed square in concussion protocol, and Minnesota ain't bettin' the ranch on him clearin' it by Sunday. Carson Wentz stepped in and threw three touchdowns in a 22 point fourth quarter rally, so don't go burnin' your waiver bullets in a panic. Streamers, saddle up Wentz for a cheap ride behind Justin Jefferson's still loaded wagon, but keep one eye on the practice report all week.

stories.headline: Darnold's Nursin' a Busted Wing, Lock Takes the Reins in Seattle
stories.read: Sam Darnold's dinged up glute is keepin' him out at Arizona this week, but the docs say it ain't the hip trouble first feared, so don't count him out long. Drew Lock already proved he can ride: sixteen of twenty two for 187 yards, a score, and a win over the Patriots when he spelled Darnold in Week 1. He's cheap gold for a one week fill in at QB, and every Seahawks pass catcher just got a nice little bump on the open range.
